name: Rooms in a row
idea: No corridor: the rooms take the whole width and open one into the next through doors down the middle line, as in his section view (cockpit, science, the mess by the airlock, the bunk room, engineering). Every inside door slides into the wall. The airlock's inner door is on the mess's side wall, as the airlock has to meet the hull's door; the washroom beside it opens into the bunk room through a narrower door. The mess has a corner bench round a table and the galley, with cabinets in the wall's top corners. The bunk room has a 2-high bunk against each side, mirrored (four bunks, each its owner's own).
